thread:
Ravi (partnerships): Kicking off a concise thread to finalize SI co-sell handoffs for mixed marketplace + HW partner deals. Need: claim windows, SFDC tags, marketplace billing mapping, and announcement signoff flow. Short replies please.
Casey (sales): Sales needs a deterministic takeover rule so we don't lose pipeline velocity. Proposal: 48h SI claim, then auto-assign to AE. If SI uploads LOA within 48h they get an exclusive 5-day window.
Lia (solutions): Agree on LOA. Also want a lightweight pre_demo flag so solutions can block a demo slot and stop AE outreach while exclusivity is active. pre_demo must include a timezone-aware expires_at.
Diego (marketplace): For private offers we require marketplace_offer_id + hw_partner_rebate_code so finance can reconcile partner rebates. We'll add marketplace_origin boolean on exports.
Ola (legal): Legal will provide a 3-business-day review SLA for joint announcements and a short LOA template. We need explicit logo & trademark permissions in the announcement addendum.
Ravi (partnerships): Draft intake fields: partner_tag, pre_demo, loa_url, claimed_until, marketplace_offer_id, hw_partner_rebate_code, origin_region. Minimal webhook example (single-line to keep webhook small):
```json
{"lead_id":"L-2024-6312","account":"Nimbus Inc","partner_tag":"si-fortress","pre_demo":true,"loa_url":"https://s3.redwood/loas/6312.pdf","claimed_until":"2024-07-01T22:00:00Z","marketplace_offer_id":"aws-private-5500","hw_partner_rebate_code":"NVIDIA-REB-24","origin_region":"APAC"}
```
Lia (solutions): For conflict resolution: priority order = (valid LOA with signature) > (pre_demo true + earlier claim_ts) > (partner_tier). Surface conflicts to #partnerships and the two owners with a short conflict note and link to intake record.
Casey (sales): Attribution: marketplace-origin deals should set sf_attribution = marketplace_offer_id and credited_ae = assigned_ae. If AE unclaims within 24h after assignment, revert credit to partnerships for reassignment.
Diego (marketplace): We'll add marketplace_offer_id and hw_partner_rebate_code to daily export. ETA: 3 business days. Also adding marketplace_origin boolean to exports for SFDC mapping.
Ola (legal): LOA template + Announcement Addendum draft will be posted to the partnership drive. Note: signed LOAs must be retained for 2 years for audit.
ops-bot: Intake API update: new optional fields accepted. See PR: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pulls/499
Ravi (partnerships): Action list: Lia to draft conflict logic & pre_demo UX; Diego to update export schema; Casey to propose SFDC field names (sf_attribution, credited_ae, partner_owner); Ola to post LOA + announcement templates; I'll assemble a 1-page "SI Field + Marketplace Handoff" playbook and schedule a 20-min review.
Casey (sales): Can we add auto-escalation for deals >= $300k to Sales Ops + Partnerships? Make threshold configurable in playbook.
Lia (solutions): Add audit logging for claims (who, when, LOA url) retained for 90 days in the intake audit table.
Ravi (partnerships): Schedule: 20-min review Wed 11am PT. I'll post draft playbook before the meeting. Thanks everyone.
